memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, the signs and wonders, the mighty hand and outstretched arm, with which the Lord your God brought you out. The Lord your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear. Moreover, the Lord your God will send the hornet among them until even the survivors who hide from you have perished. Do not be terrified by them, for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God. The Lord your God will drive out those nations before you, little by little. You will not be allowed to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals will multiply around you. - Deut 7:19-22 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God promises victory, but then adds a phrase that carries deep wisdom: He would drive out the nations "little by little," not all at once. There was a practical reason — if the land emptied too quickly, wild animals would overrun it before Israel could fill it. But there is a spiritual lesson woven in here as well. God often works gradually, and His slower pace is part of His kindness and wisdom, not a sign of His absence.

We usually want instant victory, immediate change, problems solved overnight. But God frequently works "little by little," growing us step by step, delivering us stage by stage. This gradual pace is not delay or neglect. It gives us time to mature, to grow strong enough to hold the ground we gain, and to keep depending on Him rather than becoming self-reliant. If God gave us everything at once, we might collapse under it or forget our need for Him.

This is a great comfort when your growth feels slow. Sanctification — becoming more like Jesus — is usually a "little by little" journey, not a single leap. God is patiently at work in you, and "he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion" (Phil 1:6). Do not despise the small steps or grow discouraged by the slow pace. God is among you, great and awesome, working faithfully. Trust His timing. Little by little, He is bringing you through.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Am I discouraged because God seems to be working slowly in my life?
- How might God's gradual pace actually be an act of kindness and wisdom?
- Where do I need to trust God's "little by little" work right now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You often work little by little, and Your slower pace is part of Your wisdom and kindness. Help me not to despise small steps or grow discouraged, but to trust that You are faithfully carrying Your work in me to completion. Amen.
